info.title: HERE & THERE API
info.description:
The shared backend for **HERE.** (activities happening soon) and **THERE.** (trips and travel buddies), used by the mobile app and the admin console. One account and one verification serve both products.

## Conventions
- **Sign-in.** Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` from `POST /v1/auth/login`, `/v1/auth/register` or `/v1/auth/guest`. Routes marked public need no token. Authorization is decided on the server from live data on every call (suspension, role, verification and chat membership take effect immediately).
- **Verified adults only.** Creating or joining activities, creating or applying to trips, and chat need a verified adult. Routes that need it are marked, and fail with `VERIFICATION_REQUIRED` otherwise. Browsing needs no verification.
- **Errors.** Every failure has the same body, `{ "statusCode", "code", "message", "details"? }`. Branch on `code`, never on `message`. The full list, with what each means and what a client should do, is in the *Error codes* section below and in `ERROR-CODES.md`.
- **Paging.** List routes that return pages answer `{ items, nextCursor }`. Send `nextCursor` back as `cursor` for the next page; `null` means the last page. Treat the cursor as opaque.
- **Caching.** `GET` answers carry an `ETag`; send `If-None-Match` to get an empty `304` when nothing changed.
- **Limits.** Sensitive and spam-prone routes are rate limited and answer `429 RATE_LIMITED`.
- **Live updates.** A WebSocket at `/v1/live` (first message carries the token) pushes chat messages and change signals. It is not part of this document.

Request bodies and query strings are generated from the same validation rules the server enforces. Responses are described in words.

post.summary: Development only: pick the simulated outcome
Provider callback with the result of a check
post.description: Called by the identity provider, not the app. The raw body is authenticated by its signature header; only the outcome is kept.

400.description: The request is not acceptable. Codes: `INVALID_PAYLOAD`

bearerAuth.description: The token from login, register or guest.

code.description: Stable machine-readable reason. Branch on this.

message.description: Plain-language text that is safe to show to the person.

details.description: Extra data for some codes (for example the field list of VALIDATION_FAILED).

x-error-codes.meaning: A new account via Apple or Google needs the 18+ confirmation first.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Show the confirmation, then send the request again with adultConfirmed: true.

x-error-codes.meaning: The request body could not be read (for example malformed JSON).
x-error-codes.clientShould: Fix the request; do not retry unchanged.

x-error-codes.meaning: The confirmation code has expired.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Start the step again.

x-error-codes.meaning: The person has not agreed to the identity document and facial check.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Show the consent screen before starting.

x-error-codes.meaning: The text broke a content rule (spam links, repetition, or a request for money). `message` says which.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Show the message and let the person edit the text.

x-error-codes.meaning: The day of a plan line is more than a week outside the dates of the trip.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Let the person pick a day inside the trip.

x-error-codes.meaning: The draft is far longer than any real form.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Ask the person to shorten it.

x-error-codes.meaning: The provider did not give a confirmed email address, which an account needs.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Offer email sign-up instead.

x-error-codes.meaning: The picture is over the 6 MB limit.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Ask for a smaller picture.

x-error-codes.meaning: The 6-digit code is wrong or has expired.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Offer to send a new code.

x-error-codes.meaning: The paging cursor is malformed or was made for a different list.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Restart the list from the first page.

x-error-codes.meaning: The dates are not allowed (for example a trip that starts in the past).
x-error-codes.clientShould: Ask the person to choose other dates.

x-error-codes.meaning: The upload is not a readable JPEG, PNG or WebP picture.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Ask for another picture.

x-error-codes.meaning: A webhook body is not valid JSON.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Provider-side problem; no user action.

x-error-codes.meaning: The start or end time breaks the rules (not far enough ahead, too long, end before start).
x-error-codes.clientShould: Ask the person to change the time.

x-error-codes.meaning: The first code from the authenticator app was wrong while switching two-step sign-in on.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Ask for the next code; check the phone clock.

x-error-codes.meaning: The action cannot be aimed at that person (yourself, for example).
x-error-codes.clientShould: Hide the action for that target.

x-error-codes.meaning: Switching on was attempted before a secret was created.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Start the setup first.

x-error-codes.meaning: A poll without dates was chosen as the trip dates.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Hide "use these dates" for date-less polls.

x-error-codes.meaning: The picture request had no image bytes in the body.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Fix the client; send the image as the request body.

x-error-codes.meaning: The action only exists in trip group chats.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Hide the action in activity chats.

x-error-codes.meaning: Another 4xx failure that has no specific code.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Show the message.

x-error-codes.meaning: The new email address is the one already on the account.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Ask for a different address.

x-error-codes.meaning: The new password equals the current one.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Ask for a different password.

x-error-codes.meaning: Too many wrong codes were entered; the code is locked.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Ask for a new code.

x-error-codes.meaning: One or more fields are missing or invalid. `details` lists each field as { path, message }.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Show each message next to its field.

x-error-codes.meaning: The kind of identity check asked for (for example the document-only route) is not set up with the provider.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Offer the other route, or tell the person it is not available right now.

x-error-codes.meaning: Email or password is incorrect.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Show the message; never say which one was wrong.

x-error-codes.meaning: The 6-digit code or recovery code is wrong, or was already used.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Let the person try the next code; after too many tries they are rate-limited.

x-error-codes.meaning: A provider webhook failed its signature check.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Provider-side problem; the request is ignored.

x-error-codes.meaning: The Apple or Google sign-in could not be confirmed (bad signature, wrong app, expired, wrong issuer).
x-error-codes.clientShould: Offer to try again or use email and password.

x-error-codes.meaning: The token is invalid, expired, or revoked by a password change.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Sign out and ask the person to sign in again.

x-error-codes.meaning: The pass from the password step is missing, expired (5 minutes) or no longer matches the account.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Start the sign-in again.

x-error-codes.meaning: No sign-in token was sent.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Send the person to sign in.

x-error-codes.meaning: The current password given is wrong.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Show the message on the password field.

x-error-codes.meaning: The account is suspended (the message gives the end date when it is timed).
x-error-codes.clientShould: Show the message and sign the person out.

x-error-codes.meaning: Only an administrator can do this.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Hide the action for other staff roles.

x-error-codes.meaning: The person has not confirmed they are 18 or older.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Show the 18+ confirmation.

x-error-codes.meaning: One of the two people has blocked the other.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Treat as not found; do not reveal who blocked whom.

x-error-codes.meaning: The email address must be confirmed first.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Open the email confirmation step.

x-error-codes.meaning: The person is not allowed to do this (staff role too low, or not their own item).
x-error-codes.clientShould: Hide the action; show the message if it was tried.

x-error-codes.meaning: A guest ("explore demo") session tried to change something.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Offer to create an account.

x-error-codes.meaning: The activity or trip is by invitation only.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Hide the join button.

x-error-codes.meaning: Staff must have two-step sign-in on to use this part of the console (or to turn it off).
x-error-codes.clientShould: Send the person to the Security page to set it up.

x-error-codes.meaning: The person is not an approved member, so the group chat is closed to them.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Show "pending approval" or the join button, never the chat.

x-error-codes.meaning: Only the host of the activity can do this.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Hide the action for other people.

x-error-codes.meaning: Only the organizer of the trip can do this.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Hide the action for other people.

x-error-codes.meaning: Only the person who added a plan line, or the organizer, can change or remove it.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Hide the edit actions on other people lines.

x-error-codes.meaning: Staff cannot decide an appeal they made themselves.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Ask another moderator.

x-error-codes.meaning: This mobile number is on the ban list (it belonged to a removed account).
x-error-codes.clientShould: Show the message and point to support; do not say why.

x-error-codes.meaning: A new account cannot be created for this person right now (it matches a removed account). Staff can review it.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Show the message and point to support; do not say why.

x-error-codes.meaning: The moderator who made a decision cannot review the appeal of it (an administrator can).
x-error-codes.clientShould: Hand the appeal to another moderator.

x-error-codes.meaning: Staff accounts cannot sign in with Apple or Google.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Ask them to use their password and code.

x-error-codes.meaning: Staff accounts are closed by an administrator, not from the app.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Hide self-service deletion for staff.

x-error-codes.meaning: Two-step sign-in is only available to staff accounts at the moment.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Hide the option for other people.

x-error-codes.meaning: The account could not be verified and self-service retries are closed.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Show the message and point to support.

x-error-codes.meaning: Identity verification is needed (never done, expired, rejected, or re-verification was requested). `details` has the state.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Open the verification screen.

x-error-codes.meaning: The item does not exist, or the person may not know it exists (blocked, invite-only, someone else's).
x-error-codes.clientShould: Show a "not found" state.

x-error-codes.meaning: The URL is not an API route.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Fix the client.

x-error-codes.meaning: That URL does not accept this HTTP method.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Fix the client.

x-error-codes.meaning: An account with this email exists but its email was never confirmed, so it is not linked automatically.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Ask the person to sign in with the password.

x-error-codes.meaning: The activity was cancelled.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Refresh the activity and show it as cancelled.

x-error-codes.meaning: The activity can no longer be edited (it started or finished).
x-error-codes.clientShould: Hide the edit action.

x-error-codes.meaning: The activity has already finished.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Refresh and show it as completed.

x-error-codes.meaning: No seats left (the person may be put on the waiting list instead).
x-error-codes.clientShould: Show "full" or the waiting-list option.

x-error-codes.meaning: This decision was already appealed once (a suspension: once every 30 days).
x-error-codes.clientShould: Show the earlier appeal and its answer.

x-error-codes.meaning: The person already has an application for this trip; the message names its state.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Show the existing application.

x-error-codes.meaning: This verification check was already decided.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Refresh the case.

x-error-codes.meaning: The person already has a request for this activity; the message names its state.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Show the existing request.

x-error-codes.meaning: The person is already verified; use "require re-verification" instead.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Refresh the case.

x-error-codes.meaning: A moderator already decided this appeal.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Reload the queue.

x-error-codes.meaning: The person already has an appeal waiting for a decision.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Show it and tell them to wait for the answer.

x-error-codes.meaning: The applicant's account can no longer take part (suspended or deleted).
x-error-codes.clientShould: Refresh the list of requests.

x-error-codes.meaning: The applicant withdrew before the decision.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Refresh the list of applications.

x-error-codes.meaning: Attendance can only be confirmed within 7 days after the end.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Hide the question.

x-error-codes.meaning: The host cannot be removed from their own activity.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Hide "remove" on the host.

x-error-codes.meaning: The organizer cannot be removed from their own trip.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Hide "remove" on the organizer.

x-error-codes.meaning: The new capacity is lower than the number of approved members.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Show the minimum allowed.

x-error-codes.meaning: The chat is read-only (24 hours after the end, or the activity or trip was cancelled).
x-error-codes.clientShould: Show the chat as read-only.

x-error-codes.meaning: The itinerary line is on a day that has already passed (the trip has started), so it cannot be added, changed, moved or removed.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Only offer days from today on, and hide Edit and Remove on lines whose canEdit is false.

x-error-codes.meaning: The 7 days to dispute the note have passed.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Hide the Dispute button.

x-error-codes.meaning: The host already has the same activity at that time or place.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Offer to edit the existing one.

x-error-codes.meaning: An account with this email already exists.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Offer sign-in or password reset.

x-error-codes.meaning: The host must cancel or hand over the activity first.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Offer cancel or hand over.

x-error-codes.meaning: The person is the host of this activity.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Hide the join button.

x-error-codes.meaning: The person is the organizer of this trip.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Hide the apply button.

x-error-codes.meaning: The note was disputed or decided, so the host cannot take it back.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Show the note as it is; a moderator decides.

x-error-codes.meaning: The host tried to say who did not come before the plan started.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Show the notes only once the plan has started.

x-error-codes.meaning: The 48 hours after the plan ended, in which a host can say who did not come, have passed.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Hide the action; the host can no longer add notes.

x-error-codes.meaning: Two-step sign-in is already on for this account.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Show the Security page as it is.

x-error-codes.meaning: No final dates are waiting for confirmation.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Refresh the trip.

x-error-codes.meaning: Only a request or application that the host or organizer declined can be asked about again.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Hide the Ask again action.

x-error-codes.meaning: The note is already disputed or decided by a moderator.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Show its state.

x-error-codes.meaning: Attendance can only be given once the activity has ended.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Hide the question until then.

x-error-codes.meaning: The person answered about a traveler without having turned travel matching on.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Show the opt-in screen.

x-error-codes.meaning: There is no identity check in progress.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Refresh the verification status.

x-error-codes.meaning: Only a rejected verification can be overturned.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Refresh the case.

x-error-codes.meaning: Only a verified adult can take over hosting.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Explain that the member must verify first.

x-error-codes.meaning: There is no rejected check, staff removal or suspension to appeal.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Hide the appeal action.

x-error-codes.meaning: The organizer must cancel the trip or hand it over first.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Offer cancel.

x-error-codes.meaning: This mobile number is already confirmed on another account.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Ask for a different number.

x-error-codes.meaning: The plan was cancelled, so nobody can be noted as not coming.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Hide the action.

x-error-codes.meaning: The trip plan already holds the most lines allowed of that kind (60).
x-error-codes.clientShould: Ask the group to tidy the plan first.

x-error-codes.meaning: The poll is closed; votes are no longer taken.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Show the final result.

x-error-codes.meaning: The applicant withdrew this request before the decision.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Refresh the list of requests.

x-error-codes.meaning: The person already keeps the most drafts allowed (10 per kind).
x-error-codes.clientShould: Offer to delete an old draft first.

x-error-codes.meaning: The host already has the maximum of upcoming activities (5).
x-error-codes.clientShould: Ask them to finish or cancel one.

x-error-codes.meaning: A trip can have only a few open date polls.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Ask the organizer to close one.

x-error-codes.meaning: The trip can no longer be edited.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Hide the edit action.

x-error-codes.meaning: The group is full.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Show "full" or the waiting-list option.

x-error-codes.meaning: The request is larger than allowed.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Send less data.

x-error-codes.meaning: The content type is not accepted here.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Fix the client.

x-error-codes.meaning: Too many requests of this kind in a short time.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Wait and try again; do not retry in a loop.

x-error-codes.meaning: Something failed on the server. Nothing internal is revealed.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Show a "try again" state and retry with a delay.

x-error-codes.meaning: The map service that finds places did not answer.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Let the person type the place name by hand and carry on without a map position.

x-error-codes.meaning: The identity check service (the provider) could not be reached or could not start the check.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Show a "try again in a moment" state. Nothing was started, so starting again is safe.

x-error-codes.meaning: The provider could not be reached to check the sign-in.
x-error-codes.clientShould: Try again shortly, or use email and password.
